Wedding & Event Bands for Hire

  • Indigo Delight

    Indigo Delight is a female-fronted outfit specialising in urban vibes with plenty of RnB, Hip-Hop, Pop, and Soul in their repertoire.

  • On The Rocks

    Fully-charged vocals, pedal-to-the-metal showmanship, stellar musicianship & fantastic hair.

  • The Dreamers

    Truly an act destined for headlining Glasto. The Dreamers marries both old and new material in perfect harmony for a stunning result. ✨🌙

  • Funk Royale

    Funk Royale is a captivating six to eight-piece band that seamlessly blends pop, funk, and soul into an unforgettable musical experience.

  • High Voltage

    High Voltage are a high-energy rock & pop band with killer vocals, epic party vibes, and over 100 crowd-pleasing hits to ignite your dance floor.

  • Fox & The Hounds

    Festival-style Mumford & Sons-inspired acoustic strolling band. Guaranteed to create intimate and memorable moments with your loved ones ❤️

    Afrodeziacz blend Afrobeat, Hip Hop, R&B & Pop into a soulful, high-energy party show with powerhouse vocals, irresistible rhythms & floor-filling grooves.

  • Committed to Kisstory

    Committed to Kisstory serve up the best of old skool RnB, hip hop & rap with world-class vocals, 90s/00s nostalgia, and unbeatable party energy.

  • RnB Knights

    RnB Knights blend old skool and new skool RnB with silky grooves, tight musicianship, and a vibe-packed setlist — perfect for lovers of rhythm, soul, and brass.

    Soul Allegiance light up every dance floor with feel-good party anthems, killer vocals, and a soulful setlist that keeps every generation grooving all night.

    The Riot Dogs are a powerhouse 3–4 piece with epic vocals, killer chemistry, and a riotous blend of rock, punk, alt, soul & pop. Bold, loud, and unforgettable.
